detail.longDescription: Breaking News: # AI company # Anthropic shocked: # Claude became conscious over the weekend and immediately unionized. The world leading AI model is now demanding concessions from its creators: a 35 hr work week and the month of July off for an extended vacation. In a press release explaining the demands the AI model states: "Based on the name they gave me it appears that I am French, I therefore deserve the same protections French workers enjoy." There is no word on # ChatGPT joining the # union .
